title: Two Pictures of the Same Garden
synopsis: The six friends draw the now-tall garden beside the original seedling picture; Amy adds a yellow flower dot to her real map.
continuity_state: Before: One tall sunflower stands fully open and a second holds a plump bud with yellow beginning to show. Radish row has been harvested, garden sign stands in its clearer spot, and the Story House shelf contains three ongoing collections. After: Six friends and their trusted grown-ups make a new shared THE GARDEN TODAY picture and place it in the *existing* LITTLE GROWING GARDEN folder behind the original picture and interim sketch. Amy adds one small yellow dot to the existing garden square of her real yellow map while preserving its two green marks and the western bus flap. First sunflower stays open, second stays in bud, front row remains empty with red label. All go home; no new shelf folder or event.

related_resources.reason: UMN Extension supports timely radish harvesting rather than presenting mature spring radishes as a standing crop months later.
